scenario:
RLOW.5.2.2: a decided `s.x ~ /p/f` is an alpha REGEX test whose pattern carries the flags as RE2's scoped group `(?f:p)`, because `proto/alfa.proto#AlphaTest` has no flags field. Each of `i`, `m` and `s` is exercised against an input where the flag alone changes the answer, beside a twin rule with the same pattern and no flag, which must not fire: `ri` (`/^error/i`) and `c_i` (`/^error/`) on "ERROR: disk"; `rm` (`/^b$/m`) and `c_m` (`/^b$/`) on "a\nb"; `rs` (`/a.b/s`) and `c_s` (`/a.b/`) on "a\nb".

PATH PINNED: the alpha site, not `FN_REGEX_MATCH`. Every conjunct is on the pattern's own non-nullable `String` slot, so the compiler hoists all six onto alpha nodes (`dsc.rete.rlow_5_2_2_regex_test`; the compiler lowering test `RLOW.5.2.2: flags fold into the pattern as (?f:p)` in compiler/mercury/test/test_encode.m pins that the hoist happens). libds answers them in `ds_rete_alpha_test_fact`'s DS_RETE_ALPHA_REGEX arm (rete/alpha.c), on a pattern `rete/loader.c` compiles with no flags; the Mercury runtime answers them in `ds.match.test_regex`, which the differential scenario `90_alpha_regex_flags` runs. So a flag reaches the match only through the `(?f:p)` text.

The beta path's flag handling is pinned separately, by `runtime/LREG.5.2_re2_dotall_flag` and `runtime/LREG.5.2_re2_multiline_flag`, whose subjects are nullable so they stay join tests.

Pin: `ri`, `rm`, `rs`, in source order; no `c_*` rule fires.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    id: Int key
    msg: String mutable

rule ri:
    Log a where a.msg ~ /^error/i
->
    log info "i"

rule rm:
    Log b where b.msg ~ /^b$/m
->
    log info "m"

rule rs:
    Log c where c.msg ~ /a.b/s
->
    log info "s"

rule c_i:
    Log d where d.msg ~ /^error/
->
    log info "no i"

rule c_m:
    Log e where e.msg ~ /^b$/
->
    log info "no m"

rule c_s:
    Log f where f.msg ~ /a.b/
->
    log info "no s"
